# Keyboard shortcuts

Press `?` in the app for this list, searchable, with what applies right now highlighted. Every shortcut can be
rebound there (pencil icon); a rebound key shows everywhere the app shows the key.

<!-- generated by `bun scripts/shortcuts-docs.ts` from src/web/app-shortcuts.ts; don't edit by hand -->

## Playback

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| `space` | play / pause |
| `→` | forward 5 s |
| `←` | back 5 s |
| `⇧` `→` | forward 30 s |
| `⇧` `←` | back 30 s |
| `.` | forward 1 s |
| `,` | back 1 s |
| `n` or `⌘/ctrl` `→` | next song |
| `p` or `⌘/ctrl` `←` | previous song |
| `↑` | volume up |
| `↓` | volume down |
| `m` | mute |
| `s` | shuffle |
| `r` | repeat: off / all / one |
| `⇧` `s` | stop after this song |
| `f` | like the current song |
| `0` … `9` | jump to 0 % … 90 % of the song |

## Navigation

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| `⌘/ctrl` `k` or `/` | search |
| `?` | keyboard shortcuts |
| `g` then `h` | go to home |
| `g` then `a` | go to albums |
| `g` then `r` | go to artists |
| `g` then `s` | go to songs |
| `g` then `g` | go to genres |
| `g` then `l` | go to liked songs |
| `g` then `f` | go to folders |
| `g` then `q` | open the queue |
| `⌘/ctrl` `[` or `⌫` | back |
| `⌘/ctrl` `]` | forward |
| `⌘/ctrl` `b` | show / hide the sidebar |

## Panels

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| `q` | queue |
| `y` | lyrics |
| `i` | song info |
| `⇧` `m` | mini player (always on top) |
| `⇧` `f` | full-screen now playing |
| `esc` | close the top panel |
| `[` | lyrics earlier (0.25 s) |
| `]` | lyrics later (0.25 s) |

## Lists (when a list or grid has focus)

| keys | action |
|---|---|
| `⌘/ctrl` `f` | filter this list |
| `j` or `↓` | next row |
| `k` or `↑` | previous row |
| `h` or `←` | left (grids) |
| `l` or `→` | right (grids) |
| `home` | first row |
| `end` | last row |
| `⇧` `j` or `⇧` `↓` | extend selection down |
| `⇧` `k` or `⇧` `↑` | extend selection up |
| `x` | select / unselect |
| `⌘/ctrl` `a` | select all |
| `esc` | clear selection |
| `enter` | play from here |
| `⇧` `enter` | play next |
| `a` | add to queue |
| `o` | open album / artist |
| `delete` | remove (queue) |
| `⌥/alt` `↑` | move up (queue) |
| `⌥/alt` `↓` | move down (queue) |
